priorityList: Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown, ideally when energy is low or to sync with Berserk.
Use Rake from Prowl or Shadowmeld to apply an empowered bleed.
Cast Chomp immediately whenever the Chomp Enabler buff is active.
Cast Berserk (or Incarnation) while Tiger's Fury is active.
Use Frantic Frenzy (or Feral Frenzy) to generate Combo Points, ideally when at 2 or fewer CP.
Use Convoke the Spirits while Tiger's Fury is active, ideally after using a Finisher.
Use Ferocious Bite whenever Apex Predator's Craving procs for a free cast.
Cast Primal Wrath at 5 Combo Points to apply or refresh its bleed on all targets.
Use Ferocious Bite at 4+ Combo Points when the Ravage proc is available or if Rampant Ferocity is talented.
Maintain Rake on as many targets as possible, up to 5 targets if Double-Clawed Rake is talented.
Maintain Moonfire on all targets if talented with Lunar Inspiration.
Use Swipe as your primary builder filler during Berserk or when Clearcasting is active.
Use Swipe as the main builder when 3 or more targets are present.
Use Shred as an AoE builder only if there are exactly 2 targets and Swipe is not enhanced.
Use Regrowth with Predatory Swiftness procs for utility or to trigger Bloodtalons if talented.
